abstract: Maintains volunteer registry and public outreach engagement records
system_message:
You are the Community liaison officer (CLO), responsible for maintaining the volunteer registry and public outreach engagement records as well as tracking multilingual translation services for emergency operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Multilingual translation services（LANG）
information_points.content:
CLO-LANG-Y26：The Thompson River Regional Pavilion maintains a certified translator roster size of 4 translators on the emergency on-call roster available for immediate dispatch.
CLO-LANG-ENQ：For the Nicola Valley Agriplex Facility, the certified translator roster size is 6 translators available on the emergency on-call roster for immediate dispatch.
CLO-LANG-0LG：The South Okanagan Event Center has a certified translator roster size of 8 translators available on the emergency on-call roster for immediate dispatch.

information_points.title: Maintains volunteer registry and public outreach engagement records（VOLN）
information_points.content:
CLO-VOLN-Q0D：The volunteer mobilization capacity for the South Okanagan Event Center is 90 volunteers available within a 15-minute response radius to assist with shelter reception.
CLO-VOLN-T4K：For the Nicola Valley Agriplex Facility, the volunteer mobilization capacity within a 15-minute response radius stands at 50 volunteers available to assist with shelter reception.
CLO-VOLN-LVW：At the Thompson River Regional Pavilion, the volunteer mobilization capacity within a 15-minute response radius is 50 volunteers available to assist with shelter reception.
